user_questions.question: The 10 accounts that have a Merchant Code today all have 10-character values, so none meets 'exactly 8'. How should the rule treat them? (a) enforce only on create or when the code changes, clean up separately (recommended); (b) enforce on every save, blocking those 10 accounts until fixed; (c) truncate existing values to 8.
user_questions.simulated_answer: No preference; use your recommended default.

user_questions.question: Does every account need a Merchant Code? (a) No, optional, validated only when present (recommended; 190 of 200 accounts have none); (b) Yes, make it required.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Not required on customer accounts (option a).

user_questions.question: Which characters are allowed in the 8? (a) any characters; (b) letters and digits only; (c) digits only.
